{{Short description|American biostatistician}}
'''Daniel S. Nettleton''' is an American statistical genomicist.<ref name="standstall"/>

Nettleton was raised in [[Algona, Iowa]]. Both of his parents were high school teachers. Nettleton attended [[Wartburg College]], where he played basketball,<ref name="standstall"/> and earned his master's degree (1993) and doctorate (1996) in statistics at the [[University of Iowa]].<ref name="dnstats">{{cite news |title=Dan Nettleton |url=https://www.stat.iastate.edu/people/dan-nettleton |access-date=23 June 2024 |publisher=Iowa State University Department of Statistics}}</ref> Nettleton began his teaching career at the [[University of Nebraska–Lincoln]], then was recruited to join [[Iowa State University]]'s faculty in 2000 by [[Dean Isaacson]], who had earlier tried to convince Nettleton to pursue graduate studies at Iowa State.<ref name="standstall">{{cite news |title=Dan Nettleton stands tall helping ISU scientists improve agriculture |url=https://archive.las.iastate.edu/2011/05/29/dan-nettleton-stands-tall-helping-isu-scientists-improve-agriculture/ |access-date=23 June 2024 |publisher=Iowa State University College of Liberals Art and Sciences |date=29 May 2011}}</ref> At ISU, Nettleton holds the Laurence H. Baker Endowed Chair in Biological Statistics,<ref>{{cite news |title=Employees will be honored at Friday ceremony |url=https://www.inside.iastate.edu/article/2012/09/20/awards |access-date=23 June 2024 |publisher=Iowa State University |date=20 September 2012}}</ref> and was appointed to a distinguished professorship in 2015.<ref name="distprof">{{cite news |title=Dan Nettleton Awarded Distinguished Professor Title |url=https://www.stat.iastate.edu/news/2015/dan-nettleton-awarded-distinguished-professor-title |access-date=23 June 2024 |publisher=Iowa State University Department of Statistics |date=26 October 2015}}</ref> The following year, Nettleton was appointed director of the Laurence H. Baker Center for Bioinformatics and Biological Statistics.<ref name="directorship2016">{{cite news |title=Appointments |url=https://web.inside.iastate.edu/update/16/0929.html |publisher=Iowa State University |date=29 September 2016}}</ref> In 2019, Nettleton succeeded [[Max Morris (statistician)|Max Morris]] as chair of the Department of Statistics,<ref name="chair2019las">{{cite news |title=Nettleton appointed chair |url=https://news.las.iastate.edu/2019/07/24/nettleton-appointed-chair/ |access-date=23 June 2024 |publisher=Iowa State University College of Liberal Arts and Sciences |date=24 July 2019}}</ref> and accepted a second term in the role in 2024.<ref name="chair2024cals">{{cite news |title=Nettleton reappointed as Department of Statistics chair at Iowa State |url=https://www.cals.iastate.edu/news/2024/nettleton-reappointed-department-statistics-chair-iowa-state |access-date=23 June 2024 |publisher=Iowa State University College of Agriculture and Life Sciences |date=5 February 2024}}</ref><ref name="chair2024las">{{cite news |title=Nettleton appointed to second term |url=https://news.las.iastate.edu/2024/02/05/nettleton-appointed-to-second-term/ |access-date=23 June 2024 |publisher=Iowa State University College of Liberal Arts and Sciences |date=5 February 2024}}</ref> Nettleton stepped down as chair in June 2026, was replaced by [[Zhengyuan Zhu]] on an interim basis,<ref name="int0626">{{cite news |title=Zhu named interim chair of Department of Statistics |url=https://www.cals.iastate.edu/news/2026/zhu-named-interim-chair-department-statistics |access-date=6 August 2026 |publisher=Iowa State University College of Agriculture and Life Sciences |date=30 June 2026}}</ref> and became associate dean for finance and operations the following month.<ref>{{cite news |title=The College of Liberal Arts and Sciences (LAS) appoints Nettleton and Dell to college leadership team |url=https://news.las.iastate.edu/2026/07/29/the-college-of-liberal-arts-and-sciences-las-appoints-nettleton-and-dell-to-college-leadership-team/ |access-date=6 August 2026 |publisher=Iowa State University College of Liberal Arts and Sciences |date=29 June 2026}}</ref>

Nettleton was elected a fellow of the [[American Statistical Association]] in 2008,<ref name="isu2008asafellow">{{cite news |title=Two Iowa State faculty to be named American Statistical Association fellows |url=https://www.news.iastate.edu/news/2008/jul/stats.shtml |access-date=23 June 2024 |publisher=Iowa State University |date=21 July 2008}}</ref> and began serving as chair-elect of the ASA's Caucus of Academic Representatives in 2022.<ref name="asacarchair2022">{{cite news |title=Dan Nettleton elected chair-elect of American Statistical Association's Caucus of Academic Representatives (CAR) |url=https://www.stat.iastate.edu/news/2022/dan-nettleton-elected-chair-elect-american-statistical-associations-caucus-academic |access-date=23 June 2024 |publisher=Iowa State University Department of Statistics |date=8 December 2022}}</ref> In 2024, Nettleton was elected a fellow of the [[American Association for the Advancement of Science]].<ref>{{cite news |last1=Krapfl |first1=Mike |title=Science association honors nine Iowa State innovators for 'scientific excellence' |url=https://www.inside.iastate.edu/article/2025/03/27/aaasfellows |publisher=Iowa State University |access-date=31 March 2025 |date=27 March 2025}}</ref><ref>{{cite news |title=2024 AAAS Fellows |url=https://www.aaas.org/programs/fellows/2024-aaas-fellows |access-date=31 March 2025 |publisher=American Association for the Advancement of Science}}</ref>
